name: astro-scripts
description: Add or fix client-side JavaScript in a Tabler Astro component or page — plugin initialisation, Bootstrap wiring, anything that needs a `<script>` in the rendered HTML. Use whenever a component needs browser behaviour, a third-party library has to be initialised, an inline script does not run, or a script has to be moved out of a page. Covers `CaptureScript` / `PageScripts`, `script is:inline define:vars`, the IIFE trap, init timing, per-instance registries, and when a script must be assembled as a string.
